acceptanceCriteria: The predicate schema is versioned, documented and verified by the digest-pinned portable verifier without network access.
An independent consumer reads the statement in the interop gate; misaligned fields are recorded as known deviations from the draft.
Signing with an external transparency log stays optional and never becomes a default-product dependency.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: an in-toto Statement v1 with DSSE Ed25519 exists as a prototype under FPK-V0-015/FPK-V0-030. Define a CEM predicate type, align field names with the OpenSSF openfab/generation draft (ossf/tac issue 628) and agentattest, and document a Sigstore gitsign/Rekor signing path as an optional external step outside the default local product. Owning spec: docs/specs/falsifiable-packet-v0.md.

completion.reason: Delivered by PR #90 (decision 0365, FPK-V0-033/035/036/050/051), integrated via PR #100: `prove --attest-cem-v1` emits the versioned cem/v1 in-toto predicate, verified offline by the digest-pinned portable verifier (AC1); the interop/cem01-go reader consumes the statement in the interop gate and the OpenFab/agentattest field deviations are recorded as known deviations in decision 0365 (AC2); Sigstore gitsign/Rekor signing is documented as an optional external step outside the default product (AC3). NOT_RUN: the external Sigstore/Rekor step. NOT_RUN: `make gate` locally (owner policy; PR #100 CI is the repository-wide gate).

title: proof: emit the CEM as an in-toto predicate aligned with the OpenSSF openfab/generation draft
